ValidationRule.description: Ensure "Type" Field is filled in before adding Product for all Opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Type)) ) && Opportunity.Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity Type is required for adding productsThe "Type" field on the Opportunity must be filled in before adding products. Go back to the Opportunity and fill that in then try adding product again.
